The structure of Zn4Ge2W2O12 (reduced formula Zn2GeWO6) is orthorhombic with space group Amm2 (No. 38) and 20 atoms in the unit cell across 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Ge and W each as octahedral centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Zn adopts an 8-vertex environment. Corner-sharing between GeO6 and WO6 octahedra is observed, alongside edge-sharing between the GeO6 and Zn-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 20 sites.
